note: User-provided 2025 US market car and bike lineup. Petrol/diesel mpg figures and EV MPGe (EPA-style efficiency) are as supplied. EV kWh/100mi is derived from MPGe using the EPA gasoline-gallon-equivalent constant (33.7 kWh/gallon): kWh/100mi = 3370 / MPGe. EV bikes that gave only a mile range with no MPGe or battery capacity were left out rather than guessing a battery size, since loading a range figure into the efficiency slot the cost calculator uses would silently overstate cost. Real-world mileage varies with driving style, load, and traffic — always editable via manual override.
